title: The Lantern Street Gallery Theft
description: During the opening gala at the Lantern Street Gallery in the fictional harbour town of Marrowby, the painting 'Tide at Dusk' disappeared from the locked storeroom. The alarm was off for scheduled maintenance, a staff badge opened the storeroom, and the gallery's insurance was raised three weeks earlier. Who removed the painting, and how?

title: The Quiet Readings at Halvard Station
description: Temperature records from the remote Halvard Island research station look unusually smooth for three nights in March, just before a funding review. The edits were made under the technician's account, but she says she was not on the island. Who changed the data, and why?

title: The Missing Ledger at Copperfield Co-op
description: A community food co-op in the fictional town of Copperfield discovered a cash shortfall of 4,800 just after an audit was announced, and the handwritten cash ledger vanished from the office. Two volunteers had access. What happened to the ledger and the money?
